economic_hypothesis: An individual high-platform breakout is more likely to reflect persistent thematic capital when the stock's point-in-time industry has broad positive twenty-session participation, ranks in the strongest thirty percent of industries that day, and its board has positive central twenty-session direction. This distinguishes a shared demand wave from an isolated chart breakout.

industry_state_at_completed_signal_close.identity: causal_industry with industry_valid and hard-valid contemporaneous members

decision_at: completed individual breakout close after contemporaneous PIT industry and board state are known
entry: first legal executable daily open strictly after signal, no later than the third subsequent market session

governance.coverage_only_amendment_before_outcomes: The initial 60% participation plus top-30% industry state yielded only 489 raw candidates, below the required greater-than-50 completed-trades-per-year capacity before execution attrition. Before any outcome was read, it was replaced once by 55% majority participation plus above-median industry strength.
